claim_under_test: the layered-voice control-exposure prompt fix (bc061ff) generalizes beyond the 2 prompts it was tested on

records.prompt: a pad synth with a detuned unison layer for a wider sound
an FM bell with a sub-oscillator an octave below the carrier
a plucked string patch layered with a soft noise breath layer
a bass synth with a second square-wave layer one octave up for bite
an organ voice with a drawbar-style second harmonic layer
a lead synth with a detuned second saw layer for a supersaw effect
a bell patch with a ring-modulated second layer for metallic overtones
a brass synth with a sub-bass layer doubling the root note
a chiptune lead with a pulse-wave harmony layer a fifth above
a pad with an added noise texture layer for airiness

detector_note: Re-analyzed offline (no new LLM calls) after two scoring bugs were found and fixed in analyze(), both discovered by inspecting this run's own generated code: (1) layers inlined into one statement with no intermediate named variable, e.g. process = (os.sawtooth(freq) + (os.sawtooth(freq*0.5)*subMix)) : ...; (2) a composite named layer built from two summed primitives that is itself later referenced as one bare term, e.g. unisonOsc = (os.sawtooth(freq+detune)+os.sawtooth(freq-detune))*unisonMix; voice = mainOsc+unisonOsc;. faust_code, provider, model, and attempts are untouched -- only the derived analysis/status/pass fields were recomputed against the SAME stored generations.
manual_cross_check: All 10 generated Faust programs were additionally read by hand (not just scored by analyze()) and independently confirmed compliant: every added layer has a real, dedicated hslider governing its presence (a mix knob, a detune amount, or a filter param referenced only by that layer) that the primary voice never references. Two scoring bugs were found and fixed in analyze() during this process (see detector_note); a third, lower-severity gap remains documented in check_layered_voice_generalization.py (a nested-parens edge case that can UNDERCOUNT a layer's dedicated controls when a statement wraps a sum in an outer scalar multiply, e.g. record 10's noiseMix) but is conservative -- it can only push a verdict toward fail_missing_control, never manufacture a false pass -- and did not change any verdict in this run.
